stem: 以下哪种情况代表货币服务企业（MSB）的最高洗钱风险？

options.A: 一些货币服务企业在零售客户完成尽职调查程序后，为其提供货币兑换服务。
options.B: 一些货币服务企业代表客户处理大额单笔现金交易。
options.C: 一些货币服务企业允许客户定期且频繁地向居住在另一国家的同一名或同一组家庭成员转账。
options.D: 一些货币服务企业代表在国外工作的人员处理小额汇款，将钱汇回国内。

stem_en: Which of the following presents the highest money laundering risk from a money services business (MSB)?

options_en.A: Some MSBs provide bureau de change services to retail customers after they complete a due diligence process.
options_en.B: Some MSBs process large, individual cash transactions on behalf of customers.
options_en.C: Some MSBs allow regular and frequent transactions to the same family members based in another country.
options_en.D: Some MSBs process small remittance payments on behalf of workers based abroad sending money home.
